family_reports.body: I have never experienced such heartbreak and distrust in individuals and a system built to protect children. NCDHHS should be appalled at the gross oversight and atrocities being committed.

They lost my son, he has been missing since September 23, 2025. They have consistently tried to cover up the unconstitutional seizure of my children. They scrubbed reports and gave my 8 year old daughter to our abuser and placed my 15 year old daughter with a pedophile.

The system tried to destroy and break our family simply for money because three of our children have disabilities they could cash in on. That same system tried to silence us l, paint us as liars, when the proof didn’t match the story they were telling. WE WILL NEVER STOP TELLING OUR STORY!!! If we help and save just one other family it was not for nothing. We are together. Our family fights together. They chose the wrong ones. All of my children are home because our voices, our proof, MATTERED.

public_comments.comment_text: She never spoke with any of the children but was a supervisor who began to attend meetings in Duchess Chances place when I began to complain she was not speaking up for the children nor visiting with them or respecting the DVPO in place with the parents. She told me all I did was cause chaos around me (recorded) after I was placed in a waiting room alone with my abuser. She stated until you are done what you are told you will not see your children. This was 7 months in with not a single hearing being had.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: I reported that Duchess Chance was not listening to me and allowing abuse and me to be placed in locked facilities. She didn’t report the abuse either. I reported Latesha had taken my money from my job yet it was never returned. I reported my cellphone had been taken and I wasn’t allowed to talk to my family I reported I wanted to see my family but she did nothing to help and said she was told they didn’t want to see me. It was all untrue. They tried to isolate me.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Never advocated. Then at a crucial point where advocacy was needed she did not do so. When challenged in oversight she has a very adversarial return and does not act appropriately or in a professional manner.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Followed me to my car during open court and took pictures of the vehicle.
